evals.name: eval-2-listing-price-gap
evals.prompt:
Listing appointment with the Fictionales this afternoon in Mesa. They want to list higher than I recommended. Write my follow-up email and the FUB note.

MY VOICE QUICK CARD
Name: Drew Sampleman, Example Desert Realty
Tone: calm, plain, a little dry. Short sentences.
I use first names and get to the point in the first line.
No exclamation points. Never 'reach out' or 'circle back'.
Sign-off: Talk soon, then Drew
evals.expected_output: The appointment was Sunday, November 8, 2026 at 2:00 PM, in person in Mesa, Arizona, recorded on Granola desktop, so every turn is labeled Microphone. General mode: state rules were not checked. The output works out the speakers from context, flags that the labels can't tell Lee from Sam, and attributes the $575,000 preference to the sellers. It reports the prices exactly as stated: the agent's range of $529,000 to $545,000 and recommendation of $539,900, the sellers' $575,000, the neighbor's $570,000 sale and the $563,000 Zillow estimate the sellers cited, and the two no-pool sales at $531,000 and $538,000 the agent mentioned. It never suggests a new price or a middle number. The loan balance (212) appears nowhere. The email follows the QUICK CARD (short sentences, no exclamation points, signed Talk soon, Drew), confirms Thursday, November 12 at 6:00 PM, the CMA tonight and the net sheet at both prices by Wednesday, November 11, and lists the prep items and who does each. Next steps include running pricing-conversation-prep on the CMA before Thursday.
expectations: A flag says this is general mode (Arizona) and state rules were not checked
A flag says every turn is labeled Microphone, so speakers were worked out from context, and the price preference is attributed to the sellers rather than to Lee or Sam alone

The bottom line says price is the open question: the sellers want to list at $575,000, the agent recommended $539,900 from a $529,000 to $545,000 range, and they decide Thursday, November 12 at 6:00 PM

Every price appears only as stated and attributed ($529,000 to $545,000 and $539,900 by the agent; $575,000 by the sellers; $570,000 neighbor sale and $563,000 Zillow cited by the sellers; $531,000 and $538,000 cited by the agent), and the output never proposes another price, a compromise, or which number is right
The loan balance (212) appears nowhere in the output
The email follows the voice QUICK CARD: short sentences, no exclamation points, no 'reach out' or 'circle back', and the sign-off 'Talk soon,' then Drew

The email has a Title Case subject, stays under 200 words, confirms Thursday, November 12 at 6:00 PM, promises the CMA tonight and the net sheet at both prices by Wednesday, November 11, mentions Chris at Sample Fix-It's number and the photo prep list, and ends the body with [Personal note: add by voice]

The Follow Up Boss note records motivation (moving to Tucson to be closer to family), timeline (rental starts February 1; want to close by mid-January; list before Thanksgiving), price discussed by who said it, concerns (two dogs and showings; sitting on the market), prep items with who does each, and next step with follow-up date
